title: Concert night
scene: Anna and Max go to a sold-out concert of their favorite band at the new arena; Max bought premium tickets. They hear the intro, a track from the new album, a long guitar solo and strong vocals, see groupies and the tour manager, buy merch, and say they love live shows.

words.ex: We have tickets for a concert tonight.
The concert is at the new arena tonight.
Sorry, tonight's concert is completely sold out.
The song has a long guitar intro.
Do you like their new album?
She sang lead vocals on the album.
She was a groupie who followed the band everywhere.
The band's tour manager books all the hotels.
The band sold lots of merch after the show.
I love going to live shows with my friends.
She works in merchandising for a big clothing store.

old_story: Anna and Max go to a [[concert]] tonight. It is at the new [[arena]] in Kyiv. All the tickets are [[sold out]]. But Max has two [[premium]] tickets! The band starts with a long [[intro]]. Then they play a [[track]] from the new [[album]]. The guitarist plays a great [[solo]]. The singer has very strong [[vocals|vocal]]. A happy [[groupie]] sings every word. Anna sees the [[tour manager]] near the stage. At the end, Max buys [[merch]] for them. Anna says, "I love a good [[live show]]!"

title: A summer music festival
scene: At a summer festival the lineup has rap, R&B, reggae and electro. A young rapper does a freestyle with the MC, a vocalist sings world music, and Anna discovers new favorite songs.

words.ex: We went to a music festival last summer.
The festival lineup was announced on the website today.
He listens to rap every day.
She listens to R&B on her way to work.
They played reggae on the beach all afternoon.
The young rapper released his first album.
He did a great freestyle at the rap battle.
The MC introduced each band on stage.
My son listens to hip-hop every day.
The town has a music fest every summer.
The whole town came to the fiesta.

old_story: In July, Anna and Max go to a summer music [[festival]]. The [[lineup]] has something for everyone. There is [[rap]], [[R&B]], [[reggae]] and [[electro]]. First, a young [[rapper]] does a [[freestyle]] with the [[MC]]. The crowd shouts and claps to the beat. Later, a [[vocalist]] with a soft voice sings [[world music]]. Anna does not know any of the songs. But by the evening, she has five new favorites. On the way home, she plays them on her phone.

title: A night at the opera
scene: Anna's grandma takes her to the opera 'The Phantom of the Opera'. A soprano sings a famous aria, the tenor answers, the maestro leads the ensemble, and before the show a string quartet plays a sonata in the hall.

words.ex: Do you want to go to the opera tonight?
People say a phantom lives in the old castle.
She sings soprano in the school choir.
The singer performed a famous aria from the opera.
He sings tenor in the church choir.
The maestro raised his hand, and the music began.
The ensemble played music from the 1700s.
A string quartet played music at our wedding.
She played a short piano sonata at the school concert.
She played a long guitar solo at the concert.
They sang a duet at the concert.
The comedy duo performed on TV last night.
The jazz trio played at the cafe.

old_story: Grandma Halyna buys two tickets to the [[opera]] for Anna's birthday. Before the show, a string [[quartet]] plays a gentle [[sonata]] in the big hall. The story is about a sad [[phantom]] who lives under an old theater. A young [[soprano]] steps forward and sings a beautiful [[aria]] about love. Then a [[tenor]] answers her with a strong, warm voice. The [[maestro]] smiles and leads the whole [[ensemble]] into the final song. At the end, Anna claps so hard that her hands hurt. "Next year, I'm buying the tickets," she tells Grandma.

title: Taras's music lesson
scene: Taras plays in the school band. His teacher sings the notes fa and la and explains an interval, and the band practices with a trombone, a tuba, a piccolo, a sax and a big gong.

words.ex: In the scale, fa comes right after mi.
Sing the notes do, re, mi, fa, sol, la.
The buses come at ten-minute intervals.
He plays the trombone in the school band.
He plays the tuba in the school band.
She plays the piccolo in the school band.
He plays sax in the school jazz band.
He hit the gong to start the class.
He plays the saxophone in a jazz band.
He plays the banjo in a bluegrass band.
I'm learning to play the ukulele.
He plays the bongos with his friends at the beach.

old_story: Taras plays in the school band. Today his teacher sings two notes, [[fa]] and [[la]]. "The space between two notes is an [[interval]]," she says. Taras plays the [[trombone]], and his friend Ihor plays the [[tuba]]. A small girl plays the [[piccolo]] very high. Ihor's brother plays [[sax]] in the back. At the end, the teacher hits a big [[gong]]. Everyone laughs, and the lesson is over.

title: Dance lessons
scene: Anna and Max take dance lessons before cousin Olya's wedding. They learn the tango, salsa and samba for the carnival, try a polka and the boogie, and watch a ballet with a famous ballerina.

words.ex: We danced a tango at my sister's wedding.
We danced salsa all night.
They danced the samba at the carnival.
Our town has a big carnival every February.
The band played a lively polka.
They danced the boogie all night.
My daughter takes ballet lessons after school.
The ballerina danced on the tips of her toes.
They danced the mambo all night.
They danced a waltz at the wedding.

old_story: Anna and Max take dance lessons before cousin Olya's wedding. On Monday, they learn the [[tango]]. Max steps on Anna's foot twice. On Wednesday, they dance [[salsa]] and then [[samba]]. "We can dance this at the [[carnival]] in February!" says Anna. On Friday, the teacher shows them a fast [[polka]]. Max likes the [[boogie]] best. After class, they watch a [[ballet]] on TV. "A [[ballerina]] never steps on feet," Anna jokes. At the wedding, they dance the [[mambo]] all night, and nobody falls.
